notes.headline: Bring in characters and take them anywhere
notes.intro: You can now bring your own characters into PixelDoll and send finished work out in more formats. Dressing characters also looks more reliable than before.

highlights.title: Import and delete local characters
highlights.text: You can bring characters you already have into Studio and delete the ones you no longer want, so your collection stays tidy.

highlights.title: Layered Aseprite export
highlights.text: Export a character as an Aseprite file with one layer per character layer in draw order. Each move and direction gets its own tag.

highlights.title: Swords and shields in hand
highlights.text: Items in the main hand and off hand now get their own larger, more careful treatment, so held weapons fit your character better.

highlights.title: Add a move to your character
highlights.text: You can add moves such as slash, cast, hurt and death, and your worn items are re-posed to match each one.

fixes.text: Cape, hair and helmet fit looks better across moves and directions.
Moves that have no frames yet show a note with a Make-it action.
Choosing Create or Make without a key now opens Connect instead of closing.

notes.banner: In a sunlit tailor's workshop, a freckled apprentice in a mustard apron holds up a teal cape with a bright red lining beside a rack of hats.
